Name: The Mail Insight
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Tooltips for letters collection include part of the letter text, making it easier to figure out which ones are which.

Options:
[list]
[*]Maximum amount of letter text to show. Default 100 characters. (If the letter includes internal commands like "gift enclosed", then it always cuts off at that point, just in case.)[/*]
[*]Show letter's internal ID. Default no. (May help identify letters added by mods.)[/*]
[/list]
